The Assistant

A chat thread where "fix it" from the driveway actually fixes it.

1,100+messages from me in its first 54 days

A private Telegram thread wired to a real coding agent on my own laptop, with the whole repo, memory and house within reach. Text it, send a voice note or a photo, and something on the machine actually changes.

House

The Doorbell Butler

A butler with a very dry wit lives in my doorbell.

0doors it will open

When someone talks at the front door, the doorbell listens and answers out loud in character as an unflappable butler. It takes a message, never says who is home, and sends me the transcript.

House

The house cabinet

My house has a CEO, a CFO, a CTO and a Chief Memories Officer.

0money moved by the CFO, by design

Four AI jobs that already run the house, given job titles: the chief of staff is the CEO, the finance watcher is the CFO, the home watchdog is the CTO, and the archive that keeps birthdays and photos is the Chief Memories Officer. Each has a lane it cannot leave and reports on its own schedule.

Live
04 / 06

Play

LOOI, rebuilt

A toy robot, given a brain, a face, and opinions about walls.

1 dayfrom first commit to talking and driving

A toy desk robot with a phone docked as its face, rebuilt as a voice assistant: it hears a wake word, talks back, drives around, runs the house and reads a morning brief. A depth model on my laptop GPU gives it a sense of what is in front of it.

In testing
05 / 06

Intelligence

Market Pulse

A news radar that is paid to stay quiet.

2news pushes a day, max (it used to send 7)

Watches 36 instruments and a handful of news beats, and texts me only when something moved more than its own normal or genuinely changed. Every other day it audits its own pushes and files fixes for approval.

Live
06 / 06

House

Living-room TV

I fired the TV's ads and hired a concierge.

19ad and bloat apps switched off

A cheap, ad-ridden smart TV turned into a family dashboard: drifting sky video as the home screen, a photo screensaver, doorbell pop-ups and a weekly what-to-watch list picked by Claude. A second Chromecast got the same kit in one afternoon.

How I build

Rules that survived contact with reality.

01

It has to run

On a schedule, on my hardware, while I sleep. A demo that only works while I watch does not count.

02

Local first

Money, camera footage and voices stay on machines I own. Cloud models get called when they earn it.

03

Code does the math

Filters, scores and alerts are plain code with a reason attached. Models write and judge; they do not do arithmetic.

04

Silence is a feature

Almost everything here can buzz my phone. The hard engineering was teaching it when not to.
